[h2] THE LIZARDS HAVE PREPARED A TECHNICAL UPDATE!!
⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️⚙️ 
[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2621150/_/

[h3]THIS TIME :[/h3]
🛠 ADDED [b] NATIVE SUPPORT FOR POPULAR CONTROLLERS[/b]
🛠 ADDED [b]SUBTITLES[/b] in Russian and English
🛠 [b]THE WEIGHT OF THE GAME HAS BEEN SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCED![/b] - Lizards have mastered compression technology!
🛠 [b]ADDITIONAL OPTIMIZATION[/b] - even more performance on weak PCs!
🛠 ADDED [b]DIALOG VOLUME SLIDER[/b] - dialogues are separated from SFX
🛠 REDESIGNED [b]INTERFACE NAVIGATION[/b] for controllers. Hybrid input has been added.

[h3]AS WELL AS:[/h3]
- The settings menu has been visually improved and expanded, support for frame lock has been added, vsync has been redesigned, and the ability to change the graphics quality has been added.
- Fixed a bug where the volume settings were not saved.
- When playing a new track, its name is temporarily displayed on the screen.
- Minor fixes for audio and visual bugs. Increase the resolution of some images.
- Improved the victory and defeat screen
- Translation edits
- Small balance edits, wave rebalance, fixed passive items
🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠🛠
